biometricEnrollment.cancelPendingConfirmDescription: {count} queued command(s) for {device} will be cancelled and not sent to the device. Use this to stop a sync in progress.
biometricEnrollment.commandsDisabledDescription: The server has ZK_ADMS_COMMANDS_ENABLED turned off. Sync runs are recorded but devices will not receive any commands until it is enabled.
biometricEnrollment.devicesDescription: The enrollment master and the devices that receive its users and templates.
biometricEnrollment.employeeCardDescription: Face and palm enrollment captured on the master device and where it has been copied.
biometricEnrollment.enrollmentMasterHelp: The device where people enroll. Its users and templates are copied to other devices. Only one device can be the master.
biometricEnrollment.enrollmentSyncAdmsHelp: Lets TAAMS send users and templates to this device. Requires the device serial number and its Cloud Server Setting pointing to TAAMS.
biometricEnrollment.importSucceeded: Imported {users} users and {templates} templates; {linkedUsers} linked to employees, {unmatched} unmatched
biometricEnrollment.importUsbDescription: Upload user.dat and biotemplate.dat exported from the master device to a USB drive. Large files can take a few minutes to upload.
biometricEnrollment.includeRemovalsHelp: Also delete users from devices when they are no longer on the master or their employee is inactive. Without this, removals are held.
biometricEnrollment.noBiometricIdHint: This employee has no biometric ID, so they cannot be matched to a device user.
biometricEnrollment.noDevicesDescription: Mark a device as enrollment master or enable enrollment sync on the biometric devices page.
biometricEnrollment.noSyncRunsDescription: Sync runs appear here after you import, refresh or apply a sync.
biometricEnrollment.noUnmatched: Every user on the master is linked to an employee.
biometricEnrollment.previewSyncDescription: Review the changes TAAMS would send before applying them. Nothing is sent until you apply.
biometricEnrollment.refreshFromMasterQueued: The master device was asked to upload its users and templates
biometricEnrollment.removeAllConfirmDescription: The employee will be deleted from all devices except the master and excluded from future syncs until provisioned again.
biometricEnrollment.removeFromDeviceConfirmDescription: The employee will be deleted from {device} and excluded from future syncs to it until provisioned again.
biometricEnrollment.rosterRefreshQueued: {device} was asked for its user list
biometricEnrollment.syncRunsDescription: The latest 20 runs and how many device commands have completed.
biometricEnrollment.unmatchedDescription: Users on the master that are not linked to a TAAMS employee. This usually means the employee's biometric ID is not set.
